description: Change a release gate's name, pass threshold, CI timeout or pack (the tests it runs), or turn it on or off. Every deploy that calls the gate is decided by the new settings, so change only what the user asked for. To change the tests of a pack itself, use update_gate_pack.

active.description: False turns the gate off: CI calls to it are refused.
active.title: Active

ci_timeout_minutes.description: How long CI waits for a run before it fails.
ci_timeout_minutes.title: Ci Timeout Minutes

gate.description: The gate's id or name, as list_release_gates shows it.
gate.title: Gate

pack.description: Move the gate to this pack: its id or name, as list_gate_packs shows it. Its past runs stay with the pack they ran.
pack.title: Pack

required_pass_percentage.description: The share of tests that must pass, in percent.
required_pass_percentage.title: Required Pass Percentage

name: update_release_gate
